Thanks @ncode, added an e2e check for this case in `scripts/e2e.sh`, next to the existing `cp` download check. It creates `<dir>/report.txt` and `<dir>/subdir/data.txt` in the pod, runs `kubectl rexec cp <pod>:<dir>/. <new local dir>`, and asserts both files arrive with the expected content. The new destination is deliberately not pre-created, which is the case that failed before the fix. I also added a line to `TESTING.md`.

Note: the check needs the Kind cluster, which was not available where this was prepared, so it has not been run end to end; the script passes `bash -n` and the unit tests from the original change still cover the extraction logic. Please let CI confirm it.

AI assistance: this change was prepared with Claude Code (AI), not run or verified end to end by a human.
